text: Veltris presents FitBot.
Fitness advice is everywhere, but it's generic.
The numbers are guessed, and nobody knows your level.
Meet FitBot: an AI fitness coach, powered by a fine tuned, four billion parameter language model,
running privately on your own Mac.
One assistant for every part of your fitness:
workouts, nutrition, yoga, sleep, hydration, recovery, and progress tracking.
Just ask, in plain language.
FitBot answers with real exercises from a library of eight hundred and seventy-one, and the photos play every move in motion.
It trains at your level.
Beginners get simple, stable movements. Advanced lifters get heavy compound lifts, with sets, reps and rest for every day.
Nutrition answers use real U.S.D.A. data: calories, protein, carbs and fat, with no guessing.
There's a full yoga studio, too.
Thirty-four poses shown by real people, and complete routines built for your time, your goal and your level.
Connect your fitness band: Apple Watch, Samsung, Fitbit, Huawei, OnePlus, Noise, or Whoop.
FitBot reads your steps, heart rate, sleep and stress, and coaches you with your own numbers.
Save your plans, log your workouts, and watch your streak grow.
Under the hood is Qwen 3, four B, fine tuned with Q-LoRA on five thousand, four hundred and seventy fitness conversations.
Every question flows from intent understanding, to curated fitness knowledge, to the model, which writes your answer.
And it's measured.
FitBot's answers match the reference answers nearly three times more closely than the base model.
Risky questions get careful, safe answers, and your data never leaves your Mac.
It's not just another chatbot.
It's a specialist, built for your fitness.
FitBot. Train smarter.
Presented by Veltris.
